meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 它作为发布负责人跑完整发布流程:触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流、等它跑完、验证 npm 包与 GitHub release 是否生成,并补写发布说明、发 Discord 公告。
howto.when: 当你提到“publish”、“release”等触发词,或明确要求发布 oh-my-opencode 到 npm 时接管;没给 patch、minor、major 或具体版本号会先追问。

howto.what_en: Acts as release manager for oh-my-opencode: triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, waits for it, verifies the npm packages and GitHub release, writes release notes, and posts a Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Triggers on words like “publish” or “release”, or an explicit request to ship oh-my-opencode to npm; asks for patch, minor, major, or an explicit version if none was given.

Dispatches the workflow with that exact version
